slides.title: Unpopular opinion: "we've worked here before" is not a COI.
slides.body: event venues, this one's for you.

slides.label: exhibit a
slides.title: The DJ's COI from last year's party is a souvenir.
slides.body: If it doesn't cover the event date, it doesn't cover the event.

slides.label: exhibit b
slides.title: Asking every vendor for a current COI isn't rude.
slides.body: It's the job. The good vendors have one ready before you ask.

slides.label: exhibit c
slides.title: Ask for it with the booking, not the morning of setup.
slides.body: 7:45 AM with the caterer's van in the lot is not the time to read dates.

slides.label: exhibit d
slides.title: Your own paperwork counts too.
slides.body: Liquor license, occupancy permit, liability policy. Know the dates before holiday party season peaks.

slides.label: agree or disagree?
slides.title: "Same as last time" is not a date.
slides.body: Save this for the next vendor who says it.
